name: Meniscus Regeneration (hMSC differentiation)
pi: Bernd Simeon, Christina Surulescu, Claudia Redenbach, Andreas Seitz
institution: Universität Ulm, Institute of Orthopaedic Research and Biomechanics
description: Differentiation of hMSCs into chondrocytes within a nonwoven scaffold (modelled as a porous medium), coupling differentiation-medium concentration, fiber-bound protein and ECM density. The scaffold is mechanically stimulated for 30 hours; the medium is reset each hour, results recorded every 600 s (180 frames, 30 h x 6).
spp_project: Coupled analysis of active biological processes for meniscus tissue regeneration - Experiments, statistical data processing, and data-informed in-silico modeling
